high_level_description: This image depicts a classical marble sculpture known as the "Laocoön and His Sons." The sculpture is a masterpiece of Hellenistic art, created around 20-10 BCE. It is housed in the Vatican Museums in Rome. Sculpture Details: The central figure is Laocoön, a Trojan priest who was warned by Apollo not to open the wooden horse left by the Greeks.
